# Shadowkin
These are highly intellectual beings of unknown origin, possessing a quite unique physiology unlike previously seen. Adapted to cavelike atmospheres, these creatures come from the dark. Some say they come from a rip in bluespace, while others say they come from deep underground on a distant planet. Their natural tongue is Marish. Regarding their anatomy, they possess large ears, [color=#1e90ff]very sensitive eyes[/color], and a tail for balance. It is also worth noting that their blood has a much higher concentration of iron in it when compared to other species.
## Unique Abilities
### Empathy
- They have been observed to [color=#1e90ff]sustain a telepathic link[/color] with other Shadowkin, being able to communicate through a hivemind.
## Benefits
- They have the ability to survive in space for surprisingly longer than expected, taking [color=#1e90ff]50% less pressure damage[/color]. - Their iron-concentrated blood significantly reduces their oxygen consumption and allows them to survive without it for much more prolonged periods of time. - They appear to have a certain affinity to darkness, being rumored to be able to [color=#1e90ff]see in complete darkness[/color], unlike other species. - Their [color=#1e90ff]speed is slightly faster than humans[/color] due to their decreased bone density and superior agility. - Their unarmed attacks deal [color=#ec3a3a]5 Slash[/color].
## Drawbacks
- They prefer lower temperature environments compared to humans, making them more susceptible to higher temperatures. - Their smaller stature makes them take [color=#ffa500]25% more brute damage.[/color] - They take [color=#ffa500]50% more heat damage[/color] - Due to their sensitive eyes, flashes have a stronger effect on them. - Their decreased bone density makes it harder to drag objects and people.
